description: This file defines a utility module for color management, including a list of color codes, a function to get a random color, and a memoized version to cache colors based on a key.

methods.name: getRandomColors
methods.description: Returns a randomly selected color from the predefined colors array.

methods.name: getMemoizedRandomColors
methods.description: Returns a color associated with a key, caching the result to avoid recomputation.
